To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Arabinogalactans were found in pollen tube of Arabidopsis.
we have identified and characterized the expression of AGP genes in Arabidopsis thalina pollen and we have established the presence of AGP epitopes in the tip of the germinating pollen tube.
(1) the classical AGP genes are expressed in pollen and (2) AGPs are localized at the tip and emerging region of the pollen tube.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification and characterization of the arabinogalacan protein gene family in Arabidopsis thallium and the characterization of the expression pattern of some of these genes during pollen development and germination.
the characterization of the expression of AGPs in Arabidopsis thalina pollen tubes.
the identification of genes involved in Arabidopsis pollen development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AGP genes are expressed in pollen, and that their expression is regulated during germination.
AGPs are expressed during pollen tube development, and that they are present in the plasma membrane of pollen tubes.
AGP genes are differentially regulated in Arabidopsis pollen and that AGPs are present on the surface of pollen tubes, suggesting that AGPs may play a role during pollen germination and tube growth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of “classics” AGP genes is not restricted to pollen and that the expression of these genes is not pollen-specific.
the expression of AGP genes in Arabidopsis is not limited to a single AGP gene but that the expression pattern of AGP genes is pollen-specific, with some AGP genes expressed in pollen tubes.
the expression of “classics” AGPs is not as abundant and specific in pollen tubes as in somatic cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of AGPs is not restricted to a single stage during pollen tube development.
AGPs are present and expressed during the germination of Arabidopsis pollen.
AGP gene expression is highly dynamic in Arabidopsis pollen.
